name: EPIC 210368390
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 8.2 solar radii and 1.84 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210368390 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.151838 (16th-84th percentiles 7.878699-8.468213), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,658 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.84 solar masses and 8.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,071 K at its surface.
